mcp_tools.name: structured_decision_making
mcp_tools.title: Structured decision making
mcp_tools.description: Submits a structured decision record (framing and classification, option rows incl. status-quo and smaller-step rows, criteria with weights defined before scoring, a score matrix with declared weighted totals, evaluation, pre-mortem, commit log, review and red-line declarations) and returns a deterministic DECISION_RECORD_SOUND / DECISION_RECORD_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across eight sections, including exact recomputation of every declared weighted total from declared scores x weights, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record only; makes no decision, recommends no option.

inputSchema.description: The structured decision making manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

options.description: Declared option rows with score rows and declared weighted totals.

evaluation.description: Evaluation method, score scale and uncertainty evidence.

expect.notes: All 46 checks pass on the corrected full-pass input; per-option declared weighted totals recompute (AWS 5.000000, GCP 4.000000, Azure 3.000000) and uncertainty_flagged is true.
